 Follow Milo Ventimiglia Shares a Heartfelt Reflection on a “Massive” ‘Gilmore Girls’ Milestone
 Adrianna Freedman Sat, November 7, 2026 at 12:21 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Milo Ventimiglia Shares a Heartfelt Reflection on a “Massive” ‘Gilmore Girls’ Milestone It's been 25 years since Gilmore Girls fans met Jess Mariano, and Milo Ventimiglia can't believe it.
 On October 25, 2001, viewers first met the character in the season 2 episode " Nick & Nora/Sid & Nancy ." Jess quickly became a fan favorite, and his journey from broody teenager to empathetic author and publisher was celebrated throughout the show's seven-season run. The role also gave Milo his big break, and he later went on to star in Heroes, This Is Us , and other projects.
 As Milo told Good Housekeeping , he's shocked by how much time has passed since he first began portraying Jess.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "2001—wow," he said in a Zoom interview while promoting his new Netflix film , A Dog's Perfect Christmas. "So, that was 25 years ago—it's my Gilmore Girls anniversary. That's pretty massive, because I was 24 when I filmed that. So, to know that more years have passed than I was old, that's pretty crazy."
 Milo also reflected on how impressed he is that fans still gravitate toward both the show and his character.
 "[Creators] Amy Sherman-Palladino and Daniel Palladino had written something that's evergreen, and it doesn't matter how old you are when you pick it up and where you pick it up in your timeline," he said. "I think everybody just has this common love of it, and I don't know that that's ever going to go away, which I think is pretty cool. I love that people still embrace it, and they like Jess."
